scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,app "pnpm -C services/api-node dev" "pnpm -C apps/app start"
scripts.dev:all:web: concurrently -n api,ai,app,web "pnpm -C services/api-node dev" "cmd /c \"cd /d %CD%\\services\\ai-python && .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000\"" "pnpm -C apps/app start -- --web" "powershell -NoProfile -Command \"Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; Start-Process http://localhost:19006\""
scripts.install:all: pnpm -C apps/app install && pnpm -C services/api-node install
